p5_hero_subtitle: Smart intelligence meets effortless electric performance. Designed for your journey.
hero_feature_desc: Watch the P5 in motion and see its design from every angle.
p5_aero_desc1: The P5 features an ultra low drag coefficient of 0.21 Cd, engineered to maximize high speed range and battery efficiency.
p5_aero_desc2: Active air intakes and sculpted aerodynamic contours optimize airflow over the chassis while maintaining silent high speed cruising.
p5_awd_desc1: Equipped with a dynamic all wheel drive powertrain, the P5 continuously balances torque between front and rear axles within milliseconds.
p5_awd_desc2: Whether navigating wet roads or demanding cornering, intelligent traction control delivers instant torque response and effortless control in all driving conditions.
p5_cabin_desc1: Step into a quiet cabin crafted for calm.
p5_cabin_desc2: With premium sustainable materials, panoramic acoustic glass, and ergonomic seating designed for long distance comfort. Integrated ambient lighting and an intuitive touchscreen ecosystem keep every control seamlessly within your reach.
tech_subtitle: Engineered without compromise. Pure electric power meets surgical precision handling.
exclusive_subtitle: Exclusive benefits designed for the early pioneers of the P5 vision.
card_expo_desc: Experience the pinnacle of our P5 debut series with exclusive trims and performance upgrades.
card_gala_desc: Unlock premium savings on weekly and weekend rentals of the P5.
card_seminar_desc: Seamless, rapid charging access for your P5 rental at partner stations nationwide.
journey_subtitle: Experience the fusion of elegance and intelligence firsthand at your nearest experience center.
footer_desc: Defining the future of electric mobility through precision engineering and avant-garde design. Join us in the journey towards sustainable luxury.
